notes: Published title 'Mind What You Have Learned And beat the $#+ out of the empire' contains a masked crude word ('$#+'), so the page is titled Devon Clark LS; the published title stays in the source citation.
Posted 9 July 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards are marked '(start)' in the list: Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can, Dagobah, Heading For The Medical Frigate, Draw Their Fire, Strike Planning and Squadron Assignments; these count toward the 60.
'Other (3)' is a section header, not a card: Great Warrior (Jedi Test #1), I'll Take The Leader (Admiral's Order) and the Objective.

Posted 'Dagobah (start)' dested the Light Dagobah system (Dagobah (Light)); 'Dagobah Bog Clearing' / 'Training Area' / 'Yoda's Hut' dested the Dagobah sites; 'Run Luke, Run' dested Run Luke, Run!; 'Sorry About The Mess & Blaster Proficiency' dested the combo Sorry About The Mess & •Blaster Proficiency.
'- Foil' on Chewbacca Of Kashyyyk, Daughter Of Skywalker and General Solo is the poster's Deckmaker foil tag (the strategy apologises for it); the regular card pages are used.

The strategy's EDIT (remove Chewbacca Of Kashyyyk, Life Debt x2 and Your Insight Serves You Well; add Ounee Ta, Don't Get Cocky, Dodge and Mercenary Armor) is not applied; the list is kept as published.
